3. The `EnrichedOrdinaryCategory.opposite` proof of `homEquiv_comp` (lines 131–133) repeats the `leftUnitor_inv_braiding_assoc` and `unitors_inv_equal` simp set. This is only a routine simp call that reuses existing lemmas.

I found no repeated block that is substantial enough to justify a new lemma.
